name: chip_tw_v1
description: Free official chip (籌碼) and event features from the tw_chip_data curated layer (experiment protocol 13.18 item 2): institutional flows per investor type, margin and short balances, securities-lending balances, day-trade ratio, foreign holding, attention / disposition / monthly-revenue event flags. Every row of the source tables is used only once its available_at precedes the open of the trading day after the signal date (the same rule as the short book's borrowable lists). Fixed before any model trained on it; a change is a new version.
